description: The file defines the ListViewDisplay class, which manages the display and interaction logic for list views in the SuiteCRM application. It includes methods for setup, rendering, mass updates, exporting, and handling user actions within list views.

classes.name: ListViewDisplay
classes.description: Manages the display, setup, and interaction logic for list views within SuiteCRM, including mass updates, exports, and user action menus.

methods.name: shouldProcess
methods.description: Determines if the list view should be processed based on session and request parameters.

methods.name: setup
methods.description: Initializes the list view with data, seed bean, filters, and config options for rendering.

methods.name: setupFilterFields
methods.description: Creates filter fields based on display columns and seed vardefs.

methods.name: process
methods.description: Handles additional processing after data setup, including setting module string identifiers.

methods.name: display
methods.description: Returns the HTML output for the list view, including mass update forms if configured.

methods.name: buildSelectLink
methods.description: Generates the HTML for the list view selection controls.

methods.name: buildActionsLink
methods.description: Creates the action menu links for bulk actions, export, delete, and custom actions.

methods.name: buildExportLink
methods.description: Returns the export link HTML.

methods.name: buildMassUpdateLink
methods.description: Returns the mass update link HTML.

methods.name: buildComposeEmailLink
methods.description: Generates the email compose link if email fields exist.

methods.name: buildDeleteLink
methods.description: Returns the delete action link HTML.

methods.name: buildBulkActionButton
methods.description: Generates bulk action button HTML.

methods.name: buildSelectedObjectsSpan
methods.description: Creates the HTML span showing how many objects are selected.

methods.name: buildMergeDuplicatesLink
methods.description: Returns the merge duplicates link if merge is enabled.

methods.name: buildMergeLink
methods.description: Generates the merge link for objects based on module settings.

methods.name: buildTargetList
methods.description: Creates the link to add objects to a target list.

methods.name: displayEnd
methods.description: Returns the HTML for the bottom of the list view, mainly for mass update forms.

methods.name: getMultiSelectData
methods.description: Returns hidden form inputs and scripts for multi-select functionality.

methods.name: getMassUpdate
methods.description: Instantiates and returns a MassUpdate object.

methods.name: fillDisplayColumnsWithVardefs
methods.description: Enriches display columns with additional metadata from seed vardefs.
